reviewed_points: A fixed-direction residue graph is a matching, so all t active HL partners are distinct.
For k=t+2u<=8 light endpoints, there are enough unused heavy vertices to enlarge the partner index set to k; their q>=2 ceilings pay every LL capacity.
The resulting capacity is at most the top-k prefix, so the exact first prefix reaching16 supplies a necessary active-light threshold.
Nine heavy residues force at least three missing directions, and the missing set is plane-free; summing light incidences gives3*rho<=L2+2*L3.
The proof is valid when rho>L, and translating quotient sumsets by the ring carry does not change any cardinality bound.
scope: Read-only analytic review, not an independent human referee or proof-assistant formalization.
